title: Normalized coefficient projection and singleton comparisons before Brown representability
statement: Let D be a finite-field datum [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], l != D.p prime, O a commutative ring, and t in O. Assume each positive quotient A_n=O/(t)^(n+1) is finite and killed by a power of l. Let f:X -> Y be a separated finite-type morphism between finite-type D.k-schemes, without separatedness of Y, and c a compactification. Fix any strict ordinary etale compact-support presentation S [def-per-strict-etale-system-interfaces]. There are normalized constant-coefficient realizations at X,Z,Y, with section, localization-unit and adjunction equations of [def-pur-etale-brown-projection-realization]; their proper/open comparisons assemble to the fixed-ring compact-support functor. The open and proper coefficient projection isomorphisms are the prescribed derived adjunction mates, their composite inverse is the published compactScalarMap [lem-pur-etale-system-coefficient-projection] after realization. Conjugating S.properDerived.directEvaluation and S.openDerived.inverseEvaluation under the composite singleton/geometric adjunctions gives the explicitly defined properInsertion and openInsertion. The evaluation of the explicitly constructed proper mate is invertible below the selected level. A proved helper supplies the above-level cases and joint detection, constructing the full proper mate isomorphism. Its inverse composed with openInsertion explicitly defines leftExtension; its evaluation at m<=n is the composite coefficient projection, precisely the leftExtension_below square in StrictEtaleBrownGeometry. No Brown right adjoint, Grothendieck assertion, coproduct assertion or coefficient completeness is part of this conclusion.

source.place: Constructions 4.1 and 5.14–5.15, Lemma 5.16 and the Brown adjoint immediately following it (printed pp. 21, 34–35); agent extraction of returned item steps 1 and 3. The nonuniformizer t version uses t equal to a unit times a positive uniformizer power.

proof.text: Obtain the normalized finite-level realizations, proper/open comparisons, and scalar projections from the level-only construction. No singleton comparison is included in that construction.

The proper singleton evaluation identity expresses the evaluated canonical mate, after composing with two isomorphisms, as derivedBelow followed by the proper scalar projection inverse. Cancel those isomorphisms to prove below-level invertibility. Above the chosen level the existing derivedAbove argument gives zero source and target. Joint detection constructs strictEtaleBrownProperInsertionMate.

Precompose the proper evaluation equality with the evaluated mate isomorphism inverse, then cancel the proper projection inverse to obtain the inverse-mate evaluation square. Expand the defined leftExtension into openInsertion and the inverse proper mate. Naturality of directEvaluation moves openInsertion through proper image; the open singleton evaluation identity then yields the open/proper composite projection. This proves leftExtension_below by functoriality and associativity.

proof_origin.place: Zheng Lemma 5.13 and Constructions 5.14–5.15/Lemma 5.16. Lean assembly by cancellation of the proper singleton evaluation square and naturality pasting with the open singleton evaluation square.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleBrownGeometricComparisons
    (D : WeilConjectures.FiniteFieldDatum.{u})
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    (O : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing O] (t : O)
    (hfinite : ∀ n : ℕ, Finite (strictEtaleBrownRing O t n))
    (htorsion : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ a : ℕ, (l ^ a : strictEtaleBrownRing O t n) = 0)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (c : Compactification f) (S : StrictEtaleCompactSupport O t c) :
    Nonempty (StrictEtaleBrownGeometry O t c S)
